note: Vendor certificates that may issue FIDO attestation certificates for correction-reviewer keys (server/lib/refresh/fidoAttestation.js, DI-04). EMPTY BY DESIGN: until a human pins a vendor root here — in a reviewed PR, after verifying the certificate's SHA-256 fingerprint against the vendor's published value out of band — no key can be enrolled for a SHARED_DEV or PRODUCTION scope. Each entry: { "vendor", "pem", "sha256_fingerprint" (colon-separated upper-case hex, as openssl x509 -fingerprint -sha256 prints it), "source", "verified_by", "verified_at" }. A root whose PEM does not match its fingerprint is ignored.
